title: COD at invoicing works as before, with no Charge Account
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: A COD customer has a work order ready to invoice.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds COD and work order {Work-order-1} for it is complete and ready to invoice.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S11-05 Cash and {Work-order-1} is S2-15440.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1}'s Finance tab.
  2. Click Create Invoice.
  3. Close the payment window without paying.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: Create Invoice is enabled.
  • Step 2: the payment window opens, as before the release. Charge Account is not offered.
  • Step 3: the new invoice is removed again, as before the release; the work order is back to ready to invoice.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S11-R10: “COD behaves as today at invoicing: Create Invoice still opens the payment window, Charge Account is still hidden for COD customers, and closing the window without paying still removes the new invoice. The COD row's Due text and info tooltip describe that existing behavior; they do not change it. The payment window opens for every term at invoicing, as today; COD is the only term whose window has no Charge Account.”
  • S1-R7, COD: “COD: "Paid when the invoice is created"”
  • S1-R8, COD info icon: “COD: "Cash on delivery. COD customers can't charge to account, so payment is taken when the invoice is created."”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "1 List and row menus", "3 New credit term and Inactive tab", "4 Everything deactivated and an empty tab", "5 New Customer", "8 Over Credit warning" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.
